The official v1 to v2 path is not an in-place upgrade: 1. Deploy a new Kubernetes cluster. 2. Deploy AKO v2.x to the new cluster. 3. Scale the v1.x operator to zero replicas in the old cluster. 4. Update the AtlasProject and AtlasDeployment CRs for v2 (secrets-based credentials, advancedDeploymentSpec renamed to deploymentSpec). 5. Apply the updated resources in the new cluster. 6. Set the v2 operator's replica count to 1 so it picks up the migrated resources. 7. Verify resource statuses. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/upgrade-ako-v1-to-v2/
